rule: IODA event onset within +/- 1 h of reported incident onset.
false_positive_rate: NOT_ESTIMABLE: the 20 other-operator case-windows are not independently verified normal service.
late_overlap_note: One event onset was detected for AS6147 in the Movistar fixed-internet case; a separate long event overlapped Áncash after beginning earlier and is not a new-onset detection.
precision: NOT_ESTIMABLE: one historical onset match does not define a frozen alert rule or independently labeled prediction set.
incremental_value: 1 IODA event-onset match among 15 timed positive operator-case pairs; combined-system incremental value is not estimable.
freshness: No operational first-detection latency measured. The OSIPTEL onset timestamp and IODA event timestamp for the 2024-11-26 case differ by two minutes; both were retrieved retrospectively.
